+#define FN_ORDERED_ADDRESS(reg,base,index) __extension__ ({ \
+ register uint32_t fn_base __asm__(reg)=(base),fn_index __asm__("a5")=(index),fn_address __asm__("a3"); \
+ __asm__ volatile("add %0, %1, %2" : "=r"(fn_address) : "r"(fn_base),"r"(fn_index) : "memory");fn_address; })
+#define FN_SOURCE_ADDRESS(source,offset) FN_ORDERED_ADDRESS("a1",(source),(offset))
+#define FN_DEST_ADDRESS(destination,offset) FN_ORDERED_ADDRESS("a0",(destination),(offset))
 #define FN_ALIGN0(v) FN_FIXED_VALUE("a0",FN_AND(FN_FIXED_VALUE("a0",(v)),FN_K(0xffffff00u)))
 #define FN_POLL5_AND(v,mask) FN_FIXED_VALUE("a5",FN_AND((v),FN_K(mask)))
 #define FN_COUNT() FN_FIXED_VALUE("a2",256u)
